{{Quote|I came to Lenico, and my Master saw through my eyes. I listened to their myths. Then I destroyed them.|An apparition of Exal Kressh|<ref name="BotE2" />}}
During the [[Great Galactic War]], the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Exal Kressh]] committed a '''massacre''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Lenico IV]]. Kressh, in her role as the apprentice of the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]], served her [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]] as a loyal servant for many [[Standard year/Legends|years]], but was largely unaware of the true purpose behind the missions the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] assigned to her. That changed early in the Great War, when around [[3678 BBY]] her Master gave her orders to locate and investigate a [[Ortolan tribe|tribe]] of [[Shaman/Legends|shamanistic]] [[Ortolan/Legends|Ortolans]] on the nearly-lifeless [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] world of Lenico IV.

Upon finding the primitive tribe, Kressh learned of their history and the [[The Force/Legends|Force]] rituals which they practiced to preserve the lives of tribal patriarchs and shamans. Through their teachings, the young [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] realized that the Emperor planned to replicate their rituals to preserve his own life by [[Essence transfer|transplanting]] his consciousness into [[Children of the Emperor|multiple new bodies]]. Up until then, Kressh herself was unaware that she was already being partially controlled by the Emperor in such a manner, and when the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] learned all he needed from the Ortolans to complete his own plans, he guided his apprentice to massacre the tribe. Kressh complied with the Emperor's will, but after her time on Lenico IV, she decided to rebel against her Master to end his control over her and prevent him from creating a new batch of host bodies.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|I served the Emperor for years&mdash;loyally, gratefully&mdash;until he sent me here. These primitives, living in squalor on a useless planet, had something he wanted. Listen to their past, and to mine. Tribal legends. Stories of shamans who escaped death. Patriarchs who lived on through their descendants.|Exal Kressh's apparition|<ref name="BotE2" />}}
[[File:Sithemperorbloodoftheempire.jpg|thumb|left|150px|The Emperor's incarnation in 3678 BBY]]
The massacre on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Lenico IV]] came as a result of the ambitions of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] commonly known as the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]].<ref name="BotE2" /> Formerly known as the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] Vitiate, the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] had led his people in a great [[Sith exodus|exodus]] at the end of the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]] of [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]] to preserve the remnants of the ancient [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] and to rebuild the [[Sith/Legends|Sith Order]] at the heart of a [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|new Imperial society]]. The Emperor, well-practiced in the art of [[Sith sorcery/Legends|Sith magic]], successfully commanded the rebuilding of the Sith Empire, but quickly abandoned direct oversight of the civilization and turned his attention towards a search for [[Immortality/Legends|immortality]] and power. Although he had already artificially extended his lifespan by [[Sith Emperor's ritual|sapping]] [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] from the planet [[Nathema]], the Emperor intended to live indefinitely and operate on a level of omnipotency,<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> and so sought out lore and [[Magic/Legends|magic]] from across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] that would help him to fulfill that goal.<ref name="BotE2" />

After reigning over his Empire for over one thousand [[Standard year/Legends|years]], the Sith Emperor was [[Attack on the Sith Emperor|attacked]] by the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and [[Meetra Surik]] in his [[Imperial Citadel (Sith Empire)|Citadel]] on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. Although he survived the [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] attempt, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] near-victory shook the Emperor and led him to begin work on a number of clandestine operations meant to project his presence throughout the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] and protect against similar attacks in the future. As such, he began to utilize individuals known as his [[Emperor's Wrath|Wrath]], [[Emperor's Voice (Sith Empire)|Voice]], and [[Hand of the Empire|Hands]] to expand his potency, but also sought to create a new group of servants who would embody the entirety of his will when he so chose. To that end, he began collecting [[Youngling/Legends|children]] from within the territory of the Empire and infusing them with his power.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> The first of his subjects was his own young [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] [[Exal Kressh]], whom he worked to hollow out and fill with his own strength. Unbeknown to Kressh, the Emperor was using her as an extension of his will, and was therefore able to enter her mind, sense her thoughts, and contribute his own. His command over his young apprentice increased as she completed missions on his behalf to search out ritualistic lore and ancient [[Holocron/Legends|holocrons]] that could help him to complete his plans.<ref name="BotE2" />

In [[3681 BBY]], the Sith Empire, as directed by the Emperor, emerged from its hidden realm in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] and launched the [[Great Galactic War]] to exact revenge against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] that had defeated it in the Great Hyperspace War many years prior.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> Kressh, still serving as the Emperor's apprentice, now traversed even greater stretches of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] to fulfill her Master's bidding.<ref name="BotE1" /> Approximately three years into the galactic conflict, around [[3678 BBY]],<ref name="BotEDate" /> the Emperor commanded that Kressh travel to Lenico IV in the [[Cademimu sector/Legends|Cademimu sector]] to search out a [[Ortolan tribe|tribe]] of [[Ortolan/Legends|Ortolan]] [[Shaman/Legends|shamans]] on the planet's desolate [[Ash Plains]]. Despite being unaware of the reason behind her mandate, the young Sith complied and journeyed to the world.<ref name="BotE2" />

==The massacre==
[[File:Ortolan_shaman.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Ortolan tribal legends helped Kressh to learn her Master's plans.]]
{{Quote|Lenico was ''special''&mdash;where I realized what he ''really'' wanted, and where I realized I couldn't let him succeed. The tribesmen showed me.|Exal Kressh's apparition|<ref name="BotE2" />}}
On Lenico IV, Kressh discovered the primitive Ortolan tribe living in a [[Ortolan village|humble village]] and listened to their lore and histories. She learned of their tribal legends which told stories of patriarchs and shamans who were able to harness [[Essence transfer|arcane rituals]] to live on through their descendants. The lessons helped Kressh to understand what the Emperor had planned for her and others: exploitation as little more than vessels so that he could achieve immortality and unlimited power. The Emperor, who was still able to invade his apprentice's mind, saw the events on Lenico IV through her [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and learned the Ortolans' secrets. He then directed Kressh to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the diminutive [[Alien/Legends|aliens]]. The Sith apprentice complied, easily massacring the Ortolans with her [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and her use of [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]]. The small village was reduced to ruins in the massacre and was later swallowed by the shifting sands of the Ash Plains.<ref name="BotE2" />

==Aftermath==
{{Main|Hunt for Exal Kressh}}
{{Quote|Exal Kressh was the ''Emperor's'' apprentice. Fifty-two days ago, she abandoned her duties in the Kathol Rift and fled towards Republic space. She is a traitor. You will find her and slay her.|Darth Marr, to Teneb Kel|<ref name="BotE1" />}}
Now aware of the Ortolan legends, the Emperor continued his work to create legions of his "Children" on the Sith holy planet of [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]. Deep within the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith academy]] there, the Dark Lord collected infants and prepared to turn them into extensions of himself through Sith Magic and the Ortolans' rituals.<ref name="BotE3">''[[The Old Republic, Blood of the Empire Act 3: Burn the Future]]''</ref> Meanwhile, Kressh returned to her duties as the Emperor's apprentice, but was shaken by what she had experienced on Lenico IV. She grew to hate her Master for using her as a puppet, and so resolved to abandon the Emperor and fight against his schemes.<ref name="BotE2" /> To that end, around fifty-two [[Standard day/Legends|days]] prior to the Empire's victory in the [[Invasion of Begeren]], the young Sith disappeared in the [[Kathol Rift/Legends|Kathol Rift]] and began a trek towards Galactic Republic territory. Once there, she began to covertly leak confidential Imperial strategy and information to Republic [[Agent/Legends|agents]] in the [[Republic Strategic Information Service|Strategic Information Service]] in the hope of undermining the Sith war effort and confounding the Emperor's plans to complete the creation of his Children.<ref name="BotE1" />

Although the Republic and Jedi Order benefitted from Kressh's betrayal, the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] commanded that the mysterious Sith [[Gender/Legends|woman]] be [[Hunt for Exal Kressh|found and taken into custody]] so the validity of her claims could be discerned. Simultaneously, the Sith Emperor and his [[Dark Council]] decreed that Kressh was to be located and executed for her crimes against the Empire. During the hunt for the young Sith, she attempted to throw off the Emperor's search teams by returning to Lenico IV;<ref name="BotE1" /> she was found there but managed to escape, and her pursuer, the Sith apprentice [[Darth Thanaton|Teneb Kel]], was temporarily stranded on the planet. There, he found rudimentary [[Cave/Legends|cave]] paintings depicting the massacre and even received a [[Force vision/Legends|vision]] through the Force in which Kressh herself admitted to the slaughter.<ref name="BotE2" /> Although Kressh continued to give all of her pursuers a difficult chase across the Outer Rim Territories, she was ultimately [[Battle over Korriban|defeated]] and her hopes of destroying the Emperor's Children were dashed.<ref name="BotE3" />

==Behind the scenes==
The massacre on Lenico IV was first mentioned in ''[[The Old Republic, Blood of the Empire Act 2: The Broken World]]'', the second issue of the [[Star Wars: The Old Republic, Blood of the Empire|''Blood of the Empire'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] story arc. The event was pictured in a single-panel image of a cave painting on Lenico IV, and was later explained by an apparition of Exal Kressh. Although ''The Broken World'' was originally released in [[2010]] as a web-exclusive [[Star Wars comic books|comic]], it was later re-released in the same year as [[The Old Republic 5|''The Old Republic 5: Blood of the Empire, Part 2'']].
